description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing user profiles, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting profiles, with API calls and dispatching actions.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Fetches a profile by ID and dispatches the FETCH_PROFILE action with the data.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Fetches all profiles and dispatches the FETCH_PROFILES action.

methods.name: getProfilesByUser
methods.description: Fetches profiles filtered by user search query and dispatches FETCH_PROFILE_BY_USER.

methods.name: getProfilesBySearch
methods.description: Fetches profiles based on search query and dispatches FETCH_PROFILES_BY_USER.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a new profile and dispatches CREATE_PROFILE with the new data.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates an existing profile and dispatches UPDATE_PROFILE.

methods.name: deleteProfile
methods.description: Deletes a profile by ID and dispatches DELETE_PROFILE.
